# The normative, machine-readable CLI surface (ADR 0003 §"CLI"; issue #155 §5).
#
# One invocation per line:  <leaf verb path> | <arguments>
# Every line must parse with `Cli::try_parse_from`, and every leaf verb clap
# knows must appear on at least one line (both asserted by
# tests/cli_surface_test.rs). A verb ADR 0003 specifies that no story has
# implemented yet lives in cli-surface.pending.txt instead — move its lines
# here in the story that adds the verb.
#
# Cover every flag at least once. Tokens are split on whitespace; double
# quotes group a token.

# --- hub -------------------------------------------------------------------
hub serve |
hub serve | --listen 127.0.0.1:41807
hub serve | --listen 127.0.0.1:41807 --listen [::1]:41807 --advertise hub.example.ts.net:443
hub serve | --join-held
hub serve | --join-held --listen 127.0.0.1:41807
hub serve | --join-held io/* --join-held ops/worker-?
hub token mint | --label io
hub token mint | --label io --ttl 2h --json
hub token list |
hub token list | --json
hub token delete | tok_7f3a
hub token rm | tok_7f3a
hub token remove | tok_7f3a
hub token revoke | tok_7f3a
hub token ping | tok_7f3a
hub token ping | tok_7f3a --json
hub status |
hub status | --json
hub caps |
hub caps | --json
hub support | opencode
hub support | opencode --json
hub query | status
hub query | protocol 2 --json
hub query | io status
hub query | io/alpha support opencode --json
hub status | --server wss://hub.example.ts.net --json
hub query | --server wss://hub.example.ts.net status

# --- top-level daily verbs (hub-only) --------------------------------------
roster |
roster | --json
roster | --all
roster | --prefix io
roster | --prefix io/ --all --json
roster | --server wss://hub.example.ts.net --json
say | io/alpha "reply with the word ALPHA"
say | alpha "hi" --timeout 30s --json
say | io/alpha "hi" --queue
say | io/alpha "hi" --grant gnt_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef --json
say | --server wss://hub.example.ts.net alpha "hi"
interrupt | io/alpha
interrupt | io/alpha "stop; do X instead"
interrupt | --server wss://hub.example.ts.net alpha
answer | io/alpha yes
answer | io/alpha 0
answer | io/alpha red,m --json
answer | --server wss://hub.example.ts.net alpha yes
wait | io/alpha
wait | io/alpha,io/beta --until completed,failed --after h-01H --timeout 120s --json
wait | --prefix io
wait | --prefix io/ --until gone --timeout 5s
wait | --server wss://hub.example.ts.net alpha
hold | io/alpha
hold | io/alpha --reason "deploy freeze"
hold | io/alpha --reason "deploy freeze" --json
release | io/alpha
release | io/alpha --json
release | io/alpha --once
release | io/alpha --once --ttl 30s --json

# --- global flags, on a leaf that has none of its own --------------------
roster | --debug noisy --log-format json --json
body detach | --debug none

# --- pane control (epic #633; story #670 declared the surface) ----------------
# One block per owning story, so a verb story edits only its own block. A story adds
# its positionals and flags to its own lines; #670 declares only the shared flags
# (--format, --profile, --spec-only, --take-over, the spec flags, --pane).
# Names below are neutral placeholders, not the live fleet's pane names.

# #643
pane list |
pane list | --profile demo
pane list | --format=json
pane get |
pane get | --profile demo --format json
pane watch |
pane watch | --profile demo --json

# #644
pane launch |
pane launch | --profile demo
pane launch | --profile demo --spec-only
pane launch | --project /srv/demo --workspace main --grid r2c1 --model provider/model-id --effort high --role agent
pane launch | --env ALPHA_TOKEN --env BETA_URL --ctx-soft 100000 --ctx-hard 150000 --port-policy fixed
pane launch | --command-arg opencode --command-arg serve --check-arg curl --check-arg http://127.0.0.1:1/health --expect ok --expect ready
pane launch | --command-json [] --check-json [] --format=json
pane relaunch |
pane relaunch | --profile demo --spec-only --grid c1r2
pane relaunch | --command-json [] --check-json []

# #645
pane switch | demo-c1r1 ses_0001
pane switch | demo-c1r1 ses_0001 --profile demo
pane switch | demo-c1r1 ses_0001 --as-operator --format=json
pane reset | demo-c1r1
pane reset | demo-c1r1 --profile demo --format=json
pane reset | demo-c1r1 --as-operator

# #646
pane park |
pane park | --profile demo
pane unpark |
pane unpark | --profile demo
pane close |
pane close | --profile demo
pane close | --profile demo --spec-only
say | --pane demo-c1r1 hello
say | --pane demo-c1r1 --parts-file f
say | --pane demo-c1r1 --profile demo hello
interrupt | --pane demo-c1r1
interrupt | --pane demo-c1r1 "stop; do X instead"
answer | --pane demo-c1r1 yes

# #647
pane doctor |
pane doctor | --profile demo --format=json
pane doctor | demo-c1r1
pane doctor | demo-c1r1 --fix
pane doctor | --fix --profile demo

# #648
roster | --profile demo

# #650
pane import |

# #662
profile create |
